5/**
6 * @brief The BitMatrixCursor represents a current position inside an image and current direction it can advance towards.
7 *
8 * The current position and direction is a PointT<T>. So depending on the type it can be used to traverse the image
9 * in a Bresenham style (PointF) or in a discrete way (step only horizontal/vertical/diagonal (PointI)).
10 */

116    fn stepAlongEdge(&mut self, dir: Direction, skipCorner: Option<bool>) -> bool
117// fn stepAlongEdge(&self,  dir:Direction, skipCorner:Option<bool> = false) -> bool
118    {
119        let skipCorner = skipCorner.unwrap_or_default();
120
121        if !self.edgeAt_direction(dir).isValid() {
122            self.turn(dir);
123        } else if self.edgeAtFront().isValid() {
124            self.turn(opposite(dir));
125            if self.edgeAtFront().isValid() {
126                self.turn(opposite(dir));
127                if self.edgeAtFront().isValid() {
128                    return false;
129                }
130            }
131        }
132
133        let mut ret = self.step(None);
134
135        if ret && skipCorner && !self.edgeAt_direction(dir).isValid() {
136            self.turn(dir);
137            ret = self.step(None);
138        }
139
140        ret
141    }
142
143    fn countEdges(&mut self, range: i32) -> i32 {
144        let mut res = 0;
145        let mut range = range;
146
147        let mut steps;
148
149        while {
150            steps = if range == 0 {
151                0
152            } else {
153                self.stepToEdge(Some(1), Some(range), None)
154            };
155            steps > 0
156        } {
157            range -= steps;
158            res += 1;
159        }
160
161        res
162    }

170    fn readPattern<const LEN: usize, T: TryFrom<i32> + Default + Copy + Clone>(
171        &mut self,
172        range: Option<i32>,
173    ) -> Option<[T; LEN]> {
174        let range = range.unwrap_or(0);
175        let mut res = [T::default(); LEN];
176        for i in res.iter_mut() {
177            *i = self
178                .stepToEdge(Some(1), Some(range), None)
179                .try_into()
180                .ok()?;
181        }
182        Some(res)
183    }
184
185    fn readPatternFromBlack<const LEN: usize, T: TryFrom<i32> + Default + Copy + Clone>(
186        &mut self,
187        maxWhitePrefix: i32,
188        range: Option<i32>,
189    ) -> Option<[T; LEN]> {
190        let range = range.unwrap_or(0);
191        if maxWhitePrefix != 0
192            && self.isWhite()
193            && !self.stepToEdge(Some(1), Some(maxWhitePrefix), None) > 0
194        {
195            return None;
196        }
197        // return readPattern<ARRAY>(range);
198        self.readPattern::<LEN, _>(Some(range))
199    }
